receptor_bead._description: Coarse-grained receptor bead - neutral, harmonically restrained to its crystal position (restrained-MD position restraints). Interacts via Lennard-Jones only. Shade variant for molecular-surface depth.

ligand_bead._description: Coarse-grained ligand bead - neutral, light and mobile. Interacts via Lennard-Jones only (van der Waals attraction drives docking). Shade variant.

receptor_bead_md._description: Coarse-grained receptor bead - neutral, harmonically restrained to its crystal position (restrained-MD position restraints). Interacts via Lennard-Jones only. Shade variant for molecular-surface depth.

receptor_bead_dk._description: Coarse-grained receptor bead - neutral, harmonically restrained to its crystal position (restrained-MD position restraints). Interacts via Lennard-Jones only. Shade variant for molecular-surface depth.

ligand_bead_dk._description: Coarse-grained ligand bead - neutral, light and mobile. Interacts via Lennard-Jones only (van der Waals attraction drives docking). Shade variant.

receptor_site._description: Coarse-grained receptor binding-site bead - lines the pocket. Physically identical to receptor_bead; teal highlight marks the binding site (standard molecular-viz practice).

receptor_site_dk._description: Coarse-grained receptor binding-site bead - lines the pocket. Physically identical to receptor_bead; teal highlight marks the binding site (standard molecular-viz practice).

frame_anchor._description: Invisible static framing anchor - pins the scene bounding radius so event-driven capture keeps a fixed camera. Far outside every interaction cutoff; visually a 3px background-color dot.

ligand_bead_o._description: Coarse-grained tri-NAG arm bead (acetyl/hydroxymethyl group centroid) - red accent so the sugar chain reads as chemistry. Physically identical to ligand_bead.
